events.title: TSX Comes Off Early Lows, Up Marginally
events.description: The Canadian equity benchmark S&P/TSX Composite Index was marginally Monday afternoon, recovering gradually from an early setback. Elevated bond yields and persisting worries about geopolitical tensions limited market's upside.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends Modestly Higher
events.description: Save for a minute or two early on in the day, the Switzerland stock market's benchmark index SMI stayed positive right through the trading session on Monday thanks to strong and sustained buying at several counters.

events.title: European Stocks Close Mixed As PMI Data, Political Concerns Shape Trading
events.description: European equities posted mixed results Monday, with Germany and UK gaining ground while France declined to a 7-month low amid fiscal and political uncertainty. The Stoxx 600 rose 0.36%, reflecting investor caution over regional PMI data and bond yields.

events.title: U.S. Services Index Indicates Modestly Slower Growth In September
events.description: A report released by the Institute for Supply Management on Monday showed a modest slowdown in the pace of growth in U.S. service sector activity in the month of September. The ISM said its services PMI dipped to 54.9 in September after rising to 55.4 in August, although a reading above 50 still indicates growth. Economists had expected the index to edge down to 55.0.

events.title: Eurozone Private Sector Growth At 41-Month High
events.description: The euro area private sector expanded at the fastest pace in nearly three-and-a-half years in September amid rising demand and employment, final purchasing managers' survey data from S&P Global showed Monday. The composite output index posted 53.1 in September, in line with flash estimate, and above August's 52.0.

events.title: Bay Street Likely To Open On Mixed Note
events.description: Canadian shares look headed for a somewhat mixed start Monday morning, tracking crude oil and precious metals prices. Additionally, PMI data and corporate news are expected to provide some direction to the market.

events.title: Dollar Surged Last Week Amid Yield Spike Eclipsing Weak Data
events.description: The U.S. Dollar extended gains against major currencies during the week ended October 2 as yields on long-dated U.S. treasuries jumped to multi-decade highs. Though softer-than-expected PCE inflation readings as well as a disappointing job market update toned down rate hike expectations from the Federal Reserve, the dollar closed the week's trading on a strong positive note.

events.title: Eurozone Sentix Investor Confidence Weakens
events.description: Eurozone investor confidence deteriorated in October as weakening expectations raised concerns about the economic recovery, survey data from the behavioral research institute Sentix showed Monday. The Sentix investor confidence fell more-than-expected to 2.7 in October from 5.1 in the previous month. The score was seen at 4.5.

events.title: FTSE 100 Modestly Higher; Energy, Mining Stocks Among Top Gainers
events.description: The U.K. stock market's benchmark index FTSE 100 moved modestly higher on Monday, lifted by gains in mining and energy sectors. Data showing softer growth in UK manufacturing and services sector in the month of September appeared to be limiting market's upside.

events.title: CAC 40 Sheds 1% As Stocks Fall On Debt Concerns, Political Uncertainty
events.description: French stocks fell on Monday, weighed down by rising concerns over the nation's fiscal outlook and political uncertainty ahead of the April 2027 elections.

events.title: Indian Shares Climb On Fading Fed October Hike Bets
events.description: Indian shares rose sharply on Monday as investors trimmed bets on an aggressive policy tightening cycle by the U.S. Federal Reserve.

events.title: DAX Down Marginally In Cautious Trade
events.description:
German stocks turned in a mixed performance on Monday with investors closely following the developments on the geopolitical front in addition to digesting regional economic data.

Elevated bond yields amid growing political instability in Europe weighed on sentiment, prompting investors to tread cautiously.

events.title: Gold Edges Higher As Fed Rate Hike Bets Ease
events.description: Gold prices traded higher on Monday, recovering from an early slide as investors trimmed bets on an aggressive policy tightening cycle by the U.S. Federal Reserve.
